kb.animals.foot and mouth.prevention: Ha leruo mokento ngwaga le ngwaga. Thibelela go tsamaisa leruo, batho le dikoloi. Boloka tshireletso e e tiileng ya botshelo. Bega matsatsa otlhe a a belaelwang ka bonako ko DVS.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.duration: O lemogile matshwao a go simololola leng?
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.eating: A leruo le ja kana le nwa metsi jaaka tlwaelo?
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.mobility.o1: E a tlhotsa go le go nnye
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.mobility.o2: E tlhoka mo go tseneletseng kana ha e tsamaye gotlhelele
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.saliva: A go na le mathe a feteletseng kgotsa marothodi go tswa molomong wa leruo?
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.saliva.o2: Mathe a teng a elela ka selekanyo se se heteletseng
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.spread: A leruo le lengwe mo sakeng le supa maitemogelo a tshwanang?
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.spread.o2: Leruo le le lentsi le amegile
kb.animals.foot and mouth.rec.high: BOFEFO: Matshwao a maatsi a Bolwetsi jwa Dinao le Molomo. Arola leruo lotlhe ka bonako. Leletsa mola wa tshoganyetso wa DVS jaanong. Se sutisi leruo, dikoloi le batho magareng ga masaka. Ke bolwetsi jwa tshoganyetso ya lefatshe.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.rec.low: Matshwao a ntlha a bonwe. Arola leruo le le amegileng gone foo. Lebelela ka kelotlhoko maatla mo diureng tse 24 tse di latelang. Lekola leruo le lengwe go bona matshwao a tshwanang.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.rec.medium: Dikgang tsa bogare. Arola leruo ka bonako. Ikgolaganya le ofisi ya DVS ya gago kgotsa ngaka ya leruo mo diureng tse 24. Se ntse leruo le le amegileng mo sakeng. Bolwetse jwa Tlhako le Molomo bo a begiwang, ka ha molaong o tswanentse go bo bega.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.spreads_by: Go amana ga leruo le le lwalang, mafelo a a konaletsweng, phefo
kb.animals.foot and mouth.treatment: Ga go na kalafi e e rileng ya bolwetsi jwa Tlhako le Molomo. Kalafi ke ya go thusa: phepafatsa dintho, fa leruo dijo tse di boleta le metsi a a phepa, dirisa meriana ya go fokotsa go baba go tswa mo kaelong ya ngaka ya leruo, abo o lesa leruo le ikhusa.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.visual_symptom: Mabutswi le dintho mo ditlhakong, molomo, lelémeng le mabeleng. Molapo o feteletseng. Go lepelela ga leruo.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.when_to_call_v: Leletsa ngaka ya leruo kgotsa DVS KA BONAKO. Bolwetsi jwa tlhako le molomo ke bolwetsi jo bo begiwang. Se eme.
kb.animals.goat pox.prevention: Entiwa ya ngwaga le ngwaga. Goga diphoofolo tse di tshang go ya bonnye dibeke tse 3. Efoga kopano le majalo a a lweleng. Boloka madulo a a hlwekisitsweng le go fokotsa go tletlega.
kb.animals.goat pox.q.breathing: A phoofolo e na le bothata jwa go hema kgotsa e bontsha go ntsha mo nokeng?
kb.animals.goat pox.q.breathing.o1: Go ntsha go ne go ne mo nokeng
kb.animals.goat pox.q.breathing.o2: Go hema ka thata kgotsa go ntsha go gontsi
kb.animals.goat pox.q.lesion_stage: Dintho tsa letlalo di bonala jang?
kb.animals.goat pox.q.lesion_stage.o0: Fela dintsi tse di mfwifi tse di phahamileng
kb.animals.goat pox.q.lesion_stage.o2: Dikome tse di agilweng kgotsa dintho tse di buletsweng
kb.animals.goat pox.q.new_animals: A go na le diphoofolo tse di tshang tse di tsenngwang mo lolelong moragonyana?
kb.animals.goat pox.q.new_animals.o0: Ga go na diphoofolo tse di tshang
kb.animals.goat pox.q.new_animals.o1: Ee, mo dibikeng tse 2 tse di fetileng
kb.animals.goat pox.q.new_animals.o2: Ee, mo kgweding e e fetileng
kb.animals.goat pox.rec.high: Maaka a masisi a Lerwalwa la Dipodi. Go hlokafalela ga go bua le ngaka ya diphoofolo ka tshoganyetso. Arola lolelo lotlhe go tswa mo kopanong ya kwa ntle. Simolola entiwa ya diphoofolo tse di sa amegwang ka bonako. Begela balaodi ba diphoofolo ba lefelo.
kb.animals.goat pox.rec.low: Dintho tsa seemo sa ntlha. Arola phoofolo e e amegeng. Lebelela dipodi tse dingwe ka kelotlhoko. Netefatsa madulo a a hlwekisitsweng le go fokotsa kgateletso mo diphoofolo.
kb.animals.goat pox.rec.medium: Tshwaetso e e tshwereng ya Lerwalwa la Dipodi. Arola diphoofolo tsotlhe tse di amegeng. Ikgolaganya le ngaka ya diphoofolo go bona kalafi ya antiviral le go enta diphoofolo tse di itekanetse. Tshidisa madulo le dithulaganyo. Thibelela go tsamaisa diphoofolo.
kb.animals.goat pox.spreads_by: Kopano e tshwanang, ditshengwa tsa go hema, dithulaganyo tse di konaletsweng
kb.animals.goat pox.treatment: Kalafi ya go thusa fela. Meriana ya antiviral e ka laelwa ke ngaka ya diphoofolo. Hlwekisa mme o tshidise dintho letsatsi le letsatsi. Fa dijo tse di siameng le metsi a a hlwekisitsweng. Arola diphokojwe go tswa go bagolo fa diphokojwe di na le kotsing e ntsi.
kb.animals.goat pox.visual_symptoms: Dintho tse di phahamileng tsa letlalo mo mafelong a se nang boya; ka fa teng ga ditsebe, fa fatshe ga mpa, fa fa tlase ga maphago, gaufi le matlho le molomo. Dintho di nna go tswa mo dintsheng tse di mfwifi tse di phahamileng go ya mo mabutswing go ya mo dikometeng.
kb.animals.goat pox.when_to_call_vet: Ikgolaganya le ngaka mo diureng tse 24. Leletsa ka bonako fa go boa bothata jwa go hema kgotsa dintho di konaletsiwa thata.
kb.animals.healthy.prevention: Kenta leruo ka melemo ya kganelo ya malwetsi ka metlha, go ntsha diboko, taolo ya dikgaka, le ditlhatlhobo tsa ngaka tsa ngwaga le ngwaga.
kb.animals.healthy.rec.low: Leruo la gago le bonala le itekanetseng! Le fe metsi a a phepa, dijo tse di kgotlang, le taolo ya boko ka metlha (go ntsha diboko, kalafi ya dikgaka). Boloka diente di ntse di samaela mme o beele tlhatlhobo ya tlwaelo ya ngaka dikgwedi tse 6 le dikgwedi tse 6.
kb.animals.healthy.visual_symptoms: Ga go na matshwao a bolwetsi a bonweng. Leruo le bonagala le itekanetseng.
kb.animals.healthy.when_to_call_vet: Beela tlhatlhobo ya metlha dikgwedi tse 6 le dikgwedi tse 6. Leletsa ka bonako fa o lemoga diphetogo tse di bonako mo maitshwarong, go ja, go tsamaya, kgotsa go bonala.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.prevention: Kenta leruo ka mokento wa LSD yo kwadisitswengya ngwaga le ngwaga. Boloka mananeo a taolo ya ditshidi. Arola leruo le le sha malatsi a 28.Ikgaphe mo go tsamaiseng leruo ha gare ga malwetsi.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.fever: A leruo le utlwala le hisa kgotsa le bonala le na le gotetse?
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.fever.o0: Ga go na matshwao a kgotelo
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.fever.o2: Go gotela mo go bonala le go lapa
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.insects: A o lemogile ditshidi di le dintsi di foka fa gare ga leruo la gago?
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.insects.o: Ga go na ditshidi tse di sa tlwaelegang
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.milk: A go bonala ha leruo le fokoditse go dira mashi?
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.milk.o2: Go fokotsegile thata kgotsa go emisitswe gotlhe
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.nodules_s: Mo mmeleng otlhe go akaretsa sefahlego le maoto
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.rec.high: Bontsha jwa Bolwetsi jwa Ditshwepe jwa go tlhoka. Go hlokafalela ga go bua le ngaka ka bonako. Arola leruo lotlhe le le amegileng. Simolola taolo ya ditshidi mo tshimong yotlhe. Kenta leruo le le sa amegang ka molemo wa bolwetsi jo. Kwala mme o tsaaye ditshwantsho tsa matsatsa otlhe.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.rec.low: Ditshwepe tse di boleta di a bonagala. Arola leruo mme o lebelele letsatsi le letsatsi. Tshasa leruo molemo yo kobang ditshidi. Lekola dikgomo tse dingwe go bona ditshwepe tse di tshwanang. Ikgolaganya le ngaka ya leruo fa matshwao a bola mo diureng tse 48.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.rec.medium: Ditshwepe di le dintsi le diphetogo tsa maitshwaro. Arola leruo ka bonako. Simolola tlhokomelo ya go thusa, tshasa leruo meriana ya go fokotsa go baba, tlhokomelo ya dintho tse di buletsweng, taolo ya ditshidi. Ikgolaganya le ngaka ya leruo mo diureng tse 24 go netefatsa supego le lenaneo la kalafi.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.spreads_by: Go lomiwa ke diphologotswana (menang, dintsi, dikgaka), kopano e tshwanang
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.treatment: Ga go na kalafi e e rileng ya antiviral. Tlhokomelo ya go thusa e akaretsa: meriana ya go fokotsa go baba, dikhemikhale tsa bolwetsi go thibela dikgwaetso tsa bobedi, go apesa dintho tse di buletsweng, le dijo tse di siameng. Taolo ya ditshidi ke ya botlhokwa go thibela go anamela.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.visual_symp: Ditshwepe tse di phahamileng tsa go bopama tsa 2-5cm mo mmeleng wotlhe. Ditshwepe di ka tsholola metsi. Maotwana a a rulagantsweng a bonala mo molaleng le maotong.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.when_to_cal: Ikgolaganya le ngaka mo diureng tse 24. Leletsa ba bonako fa leruo le emisa go ja, o bona kgotelo e masisi, kgotsa ditshwepe di bula mme di konaletsiwa.
kb.plants.healthy.prevention: Boloka taolo ya magora, lebelela dikeledi dibeke le dibeke, netefatsa go ntsha metsi go go siameng, dirisa mefuta e e ganang bolwetsi fa e teng, le go phuthologa ga dibjalo kotulo le kotulo.
kb.plants.healthy.rec.low: Dibjalo tsa gago di bonala di itekanetseng! Tswelela go lebelela ka metlha. Netefatsa go nesa go go tshwanang, go fepa ka kelotlhoko, go ntsha metsi go go siameng, le taolo ya magora. Batlhela dikeledi le matshwao a bolwetsi dibeke le dibeke, le go phuthologa ga dibjalo kotulo le kotulo.
kb.plants.healthy.visual_symptoms: Ga go na matshwao a bolwetsi a bonweng. Semela se bonala se itekanetseng le mmala o tlwaelegang wa matlhare le go gola.
kb.plants.healthy.when_to_call_vet: Ikgolaganya le mokwaledi wa temo fa o lemoga go ntshwa mmala, go fela, dintshi kgotsa dintho tse di sa tlwaelegang, go bola, kgotsa tiro e ntsi ya dikeledi.
kb.plants.potato late blight.display_nam: Bolwetsi jwa Blight ya Mabela a Lefatshe
kb.plants.potato late blight.prevention: Dirisa mabela a peo a a netefaditsweng, a a se nang bolwetsi. Jala mefuta e e ganang blight. Roba mmung mo mela go sireletsa mabela a a golang go tswa mo diporeng. Diriisa setlhare sa thibelo sa obomela pele ga bossa jo bo na le pula. Phuthologo ya dibjalo ya dingwaga tse 3 le dibjalo tse di sa amaneng le solanaceous.
kb.plants.potato late blight.q.humidity: Maemo a bosa a ne jang mo dibikeng tse di fetileng?
Go tonya le pula e sele kgotsa majwe a masa
Go tonya, go na le metsi le go fifala mo malatsi a mmalwa
kb.plants.potato late blight.q.spread_sp: Dintho di phatlalala ka bonako jang?
Go phatlalala ka bonako thata mo diureng tse 24-48
kb.plants.potato late blight.q.tuber_aff: Fa o epa mabela, a mangwe a bontsha go bola kgotsa go fetoga mmala?
Ga go na mabela a a lekodilweng kgotsa otlhe a bonala sentle
kb.plants.potato late blight.rec.high: GO MASISI: Go hlokafalela ga tiro ya tshoganyetso. Diriisa setlhare sa obomela sa systemic ka bonako, kgotsa o omise mme o kotule dintlha pele go thibela dipora go fitlhela mabela. Kotula mabela fela fa matlhare a sule mme mmung o omile go le gonye. O se ka wa boloka mabela ape a a nang le matshwao a go bola. O se ka wa jala mabela a lefatshe kgotsa dimatamatisi mo tikologong eno go ya bonnye go ya go dikgwedi tse 2.
kb.plants.potato late blight.rec.low: Matshwao a ntlha a blight. Diriisa setlhare sa obomela sa go thewa mo kopore kgotsa mancozeb ka bonako. Tlose matlhare a a konaletsweng. Tokafatsa go gololosega ga mowa magareng ga dimela. Efoga go kgotsa matlhare fa o nesa. Lebelela letsatsi le letsatsi, segolo bogolo morago ga pula.
kb.plants.potato late blight.rec.medium: Blight e e tshwereng mo mabeleng a lefatshe. Diriisa setlhare sa obomela sa systemic (metalaxyl kgotsa cymoxanil) dikgwedi tse 5-7 le dikgwedi tse 5-7. Khutlisa go nesa go go tswang godimo. Tlose mme o senya dithoto tsotlhe tsa semela tse di konaletsweng kwa ntle ga tshimo. Efoga go epa mabela mo mmung o o metsi, gonne se anamisa dipora mo mabeleng a a itekanetseng.
kb.plants.potato late blight.spreads_by: Dipora tse di isiswang ke mowa, go tshilafala ga metsi, mabela a peo a a konaletsweng, dipuno tse di konaletsweng
kb.plants.potato late blight.treatment: Disetlhare tse di tshwanang le tsa blight ya moragonyana ya tamati: metalaxyl, cymoxanil, fenamidone go tiro ya go alafa. Mancozeb le chlorothalonil go tshireletso ya thibelo. Fetola dikolo nako yotlhe go thibela kgaolo ya setlhare sa obomela. Omisa mabela a a kotulweng (poloko e e omileng, e e fefolang sentle) pele ga poloko ya nako e telele go fokotsa go anamela ga go bola.
kb.plants.potato late blight.visual_symp: Dintho tse di botlhole tse di fifetseng tse di tshitlhilweng ke metsi mo matlharen, gantsi go simolola mo mathomong a matlhare. Obomela o o tshweu o bonala mo tlase ga matlhare fa go na le bomolelo. Dintho tse di fifetseng mo matlhobong. Mabela a bontsha go bola jo bo bohibidu-bosootho ka fa tlase ga letlalo mme a ka tswelela go bola fa a bolokwa. Dimela di ka we mo malatsi a sele fa bosa bo na le pula.
kb.plants.potato late blight.when_to_cal: Ikgolaganya le mokwaledi wa temo ka bonako. Blight ya mabela a lefatshe e ka senya dibjalo tsotlhe, matlhare le mabela a a bolokweng, mo malatsing a sele fa maemo a tonya le a na le metsi — dira ka bonako.
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.disp: Bolwetsi jwa Mooko wa Mabele a Sorghum
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.prev: Jala mefuta ya sorghum e e ganang mooko. Diriisa setlhare sa obomela mo seheng sa 50% sa go thunya. Kotula ka bonako fa go boa bogolo. Efoga go jala morago ga nako go go diegelang kotulo go ya mo go kotulo e nang le pula. Netefatsa maemo a a siameng a poloko ya lebese.
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.q.ha: A dibjalo di sesiwa go kotulwa kgotsa di feta bogolo?
Di sale dibeke tse 2-4 go fitlha go kotulo
Di feta nako e e siameng ya kotulo
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.q.mo: Kae ga hlogo ya lebese e amegile?
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.q.we: Bosa bo ne jang nakong ya go tlala le go gola ga lebese?
Pula e sele nakong ya go tlala ga lebese
Pula e gantsi le bomolelo jo bogolo
Mooko o masisi wa lebese. Kotula ka bonako go baakanywa ga seemo sa bogolo. Lebese le le konaletsweng thata ke mooko ga le tshwanela go jewa ke batho kgotsa go fepiwa diphoofolo ka ntlha ya mycotoxins. Ikgolaganya le mokwaledi wa temo go bona kgakololo ya go lahlela lebese. Batlhela mefuta e e ganang mooko go kotulo e e latelang.

Matshwao a ntlha a mooko a bonwe. Fa go le gaufi le kotulo, kotula pele go thibela go anamela. Netefatsa go gololosega ga mowa o o siameng gaufi le dihlohlong tsa lebese. Diriisa setlhare sa obomela fa dibjalo di sale dibeke go fitlha go kotulo mme maemo a ntse a na le metsi.

Mooko wa lebese wa bogare. Kotula ka bonako kamoka — se letele. Omisa lebese le le kotulwang ka bonako go ya ka fa tlase ga 13% ya metsi. Arola lebese le le konaletsweng ke mooko go tswa go lebese le le itekanetse. O se ka wa fepa diphoofolo lebese le le konaletsweng thata ke mooko fa mycotoxins e ka nna ya kotsi.
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.spre: Dipora tsa obomela tse di isiswang ke mowa le pula, go gobala ga lebese ke dikeledi go tlhoma mafelo a a tsenang
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.trea: Fa mooko wa lebese o sena go tlhagela, setlhare sa obomela se na le ditlamorago tse di fokotsegeng. Go diriisa setlhare sa thibelo sa obomela nakong ya go thunya (e.g. propiconazole) ke go nepagala thata. Kotula pele mo dikgweding tse di na le pula. Boloka lebese ka fa tlase ga 13% ya metsi go thibela mooko morago ga kotulo.
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.visu: Go mmina ga mmala wa boshibidu, bohibidu, botlhoki kgotsa boso mo dihlohlong tsa lebese. Lebese le le kgontshitsweng kgotsa le le fetotsegileng mmala. Go gola ga obomela o o tshweu kgotsa o o botlhoki o o bonalang gare ga dikone tsa lebese.
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.when: Ikgolaganya le mokwaledi wa temo wa gago wa lefelo kgotsa le Lefapha la Temo fa mooko o amega go feta 30% ya dibjalo tsa gago kgotsa fa o belaela tshwaetso ya mycotoxin.

kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.rec.hi: Maaka a masisi mo tshimong yotlhe. Tlose mme o tshube dimela tsotlhe tse di konaletsweng. O SE ka wa di bea mo dirakeng. Diriisa setlhare sa go bolaya dikeledi sa systemic. O se ka wa jala dibjalo tse di tshwanang mo tshimong eno go ya bonnye go ya go kotulo e e latelang. Batlhela mefuta e e ganang bolwetsi go jala gape.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.rec.lo: Matshwao a ntlha a bolwetsi jwa mosaic mo dimeleng di sele. Tlose mme o senya matlhare a a amegeng. Diriisa setlhare sa go bolaya dikeledi go laola diaflid. O se ka wa dira mo dimeleng tse di itekanetse morago ga go ama tse di amegeng ntle le go tlhapa diatla. Lebelela dimela tse dingwe letsatsi le letsatsi.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.rec.me: Go anamela ga bolwetsi jwa mosaic jwa bogare. Tlose dimela tsotlhe tse di bonalang di konaletsiwa mme o di senya kwa ntle ga tshimo. Kofa dimela tse di setseng ka setlhare se se kailweng sa go bolaya dikeledi go laola diaflid. O se ka wa jala dimela tse di tshwanang mo lefelong leno dikgwedi tse di latelang. Nayang malwethi a a nyenyang matlhare go thibela diaflid.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.spread: Dikeledi tsa aphid, dimela tse di konaletsweng, didirisiwa tsa go tlhoma
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.treatm: Ga go na kalafi ya tshwaetso ya borokgwe. Taolo fela: tlose dimela tse di konaletsweng, laola diaflid ka setlhare sa go bolaya dikeledi (e.g. imidacloprid, pyrethroids), diriisa malwethi a a nyenyang matlhare, le go jala mefuta e e ganang bolwetsi mo dikgweding tse di latelang.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.visual: Go mmina ga mmala wa botala jo bo sootho-botala mo matlharen. Go phatalogana le go phetologa ga matlhare. Leungo le le nang le mmala o o sa lekalekang, bogolo jo bonnyane kgotsa bogobe mo go jona. Go gola go emeng ga semela.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.when_t: Bua le mokwaledi wa temo fa go feta 20% ya dibjalo tsa gago di amegile, kgotsa fa o tlhoka thuso go tlhagisa setlhare se se nepileng sa go bolaya dikeledi.
learn.african swine fever.affects: Dikolobe (tsa mo gae le tsa naga).
learn.african swine fever.prevention: Tila go fepa dikolobe ka tsela e e feteletseng, laola go tsamaya ga dikolobe, go phepafatsa didirisiwa le dikoloi fa gare ga dipolasi, le go bega dikolobe tse di lwalang kana tse di suleng ka bonako.
learn.african swine fever.spreads_by: Go kopana ka tlhamalalo le dikolobe tse di tshwaeditsweng, furu kgotsa didirisiwa tse di kgotletsweng, ditshenekegi (ditshenekegi tse di borethe tsa losika lwa Ornithodoros) le go ja dijo tse di tsididi.
learn.african swine fever.symptoms: Go nna le letshoroma le le kwa godimo, go sa nne le keletso ya dijo, go nna le matheba a mmala o mohibidu kgotsa o mohibidu mo letlalong, go hlatsa, letshololo, loso lo lo sa lebelelwang.
learn.african swine fever.what_to_do: Go begela ngaka ya diphologolo ka yone nako eo  ke bolwetse jo bo tshwanetseng go begelwa. Ga go na kalafi epe kgotsa moento o o amogetsweng, ka jalo metlhape e e amilweng ke bolwetse jono gantsi e kgaoganngwa le go bolawa gore e se ka ya anama.
learn.anthrax.affects: Dikgomo, dinku, dipodi le diphologolo tse dingwe tse di fulang. Zoonotic  e ka tshwaetsa batho ka go kopana le ditopo kgotsa dilwana tse di tshwaeditsweng.
learn.anthrax.prevention: Romela diruiwa mo mafelong a a itsegeng gore a na le bolwetse jwa anthrax, tila go fula mo nageng e e nang le batho ba ba suleng ka ntlha ya anthrax, mme o latlhele ditopo ka pabalesego le ka bonako.
learn.anthrax.spreads_by: Go jewa ga di-spore tse di tswang mo mmung o o kgotletsweng kana mo mafulo, segolobogolo morago ga go kgoreletsega ga mmu kana merwalela mo dikgaolong tse di nang le bolwetse.
learn.anthrax.symptoms: Gantsi go swa ka tshoganyetso ke sesupo sa ntlha; gape go na le letshoroma, bothata jwa go hema, go idibala le go tshologa madi ka ntlha ya go bulega ga mmele (nko, molomo, nko) fa motho a sena go swa.
learn.anthrax.what_to_do: O SE ka wa bula kgotsa wa dira patlisiso ya morago ga loso mo setlhabelong se go belaelwang gore se na le anthrax  seno se tla dira gore go nne le di-spore. Go begela ngaka ya diphologolo ka bonako gore e go tlhomamisetse le gore setopo se tlosiwe ka pabalesego (se se fisitsweng kgotsa se se fitlhetsweng kwa teng ka letsopa).
learn.blackleg.affects: Dikgomo tse dinnye (dikgwedi di le thataro go ya go di le pedi) segolobogolo; ka dinako tse dingwe dinku.
learn.blackleg.prevention: Romela dikgomo tse dinnye thibelo ngwaga le ngwaga mo mafelong a a nang le histori ya mokwatla o montsho, mme o tile go fula mo nageng e go kileng ga nna le batho ba ba nang le bolwetse jono.
learn.blackleg.spreads_by: E bakwa ke dibakateria tsa Clostridium tse di tswang mo mmung tse di tsenang ka dintho kgotsa tse di tsenwang mo mmung; di-spore di ka tshela mo mmung ka dingwaga di le dintsi.
learn.blackleg.symptoms: Go golafala ka tshoganyetso, go ruruga mo dikarolong tse di kwa morago tsa mmele kgotsa mo legetleng le le phatlogang kafa tlase ga letlalo (gase kafa tlase ga letlalo), letshoroma le le kwa godimo, loso lwa ka tshoganyetso, gantsi mo dikgomo tse dinnye tse di nang le botsogo jo bo siameng.
learn.blackleg.what_to_do: Go ikgolaganya le ngaka ya diphologolo ka bonako  Dibolayamegare di ka thusa fa di lemogiwa go sa le gale, mme bolwetse jono bo tswelela ka bonako mme gantsi bo a bolaya. Go kgothalediwa gore motlhape o o setseng o thibelwe morago ga leroborobo.
learn.brucellosis.affects: Dikgomo, dipodi, dinku le dikolobe. Gape di ka tshwaetsa batho (di-zoonotic) ka go kopana le diphologolo tse di tshwaeditsweng, metsi a a tswang mo popelong kgotsa mashi a a sa tsenngwang ke pasteur.
learn.brucellosis.prevention: Romela dikolobe/bana melemo fa go na le thulaganyo ya bosetšhaba, tlhatlhoba le go tlosa diphologolo tse di tshwaeditsweng, mme o dirise maswi go a disa pele ga o a ja.
learn.brucellosis.spreads_by: Go kopana le masea a a senyegileng mo popelong, lesea le le tsetsweng le metsi a a tswang mo popelong; mashi a a kgotletsweng; go ikatisa le diphologolo tse di tshwaeditsweng.
learn.brucellosis.symptoms: Go senya mpa kwa bofelong jwa go ima, go boloka setlhabi, go fokotsa botsalo, go ruruga ga malokololo; gantsi ga go na matshwao ape a a bonalang kwantle ga go ima.
learn.brucellosis.what_to_do: Kgaoganya diphologolo tse di santseng di senya mpa, tila go tshwara dijo tsa pelegi ka diatla, mme ikgolaganye le ngaka ya diphologolo gore o e tlhatlhobe. Diphologolo tse di tshwaeditsweng gantsi di bolawa e le karolo ya dithulaganyo tsa go laola.
learn.cassava mosaic disease.prevention: Mefuta ya dimela e e kgonang go emelana le dimela, dirisa ditshenekegi tse di phepa/tse di nang le setifikeiti, mme o laole ditlhopha tsa di-whitefly.
learn.cassava mosaic disease.spreads_by: Di-whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci) le go dirisiwa ga ditshenekegi tse di tshwaeditsweng go jala.
learn.cassava mosaic disease.symptoms: Paterone ya mosaic ya matlhare a botala jo bo serolwana, go kgorelediwa ga matlhare le go kgorelediwa ga one, kgolo ya dimela e e kgoreletsang, go fokotsega ga thobo ya tuber (motswedi).
learn.cassava mosaic disease.what_to_do: Tlosa le go senya dimela tse di tshwaeditsweng. Ka metlha o ka nna wa tsaya dilo tsa go jala (di-cutting) go tswa mo setlhareng se se tlhomamisitsweng se se senang malwetse go na le gore o di tsenye mo tshimong e e tshwaeditsweng.
learn.foot and mouth.prevention: Entiwa ya metlha, thibela go tsamaisa leruo, dirisa dikgato tsa tshireletso ya bophelo.
learn.foot and mouth.spreads_by: Kopano le leruo le lweleng, mafelo a a amegeng
learn.foot and mouth.symptoms: Mabutswi mo dinao, molomong le lelémeng. Molapo o feteletseng, go sa je, pholo e e fokotsegile.
learn.foot and mouth.what_to_do: Arola leruo le lweleng ka bonako. Ikgolaganya le ngaka ya leruo kgotsa ofisi ya DVS. Se tsamaise leruo. Begela balaodi, bolwetsi jwa tlhako le molomo ke bolwetsi jo bo begiwang mo pusong.
learn.goat pox.prevention: Entiwa ya ngwaga le ngwaga, tlhokomelo ya leruo, efoga kopano le leruo tse di lweleng.
learn.goat pox.spreads_by: Kopano le leruo tse di lweleng, mowa
learn.goat pox.symptoms: Diphupho tse di tshogileng mo letlalong, feberu, molapo wa nko, go thata go hema.
learn.goat pox.what_to_do: Arola leruo. Ikgolaganya le ngaka ya leruo go bona kalafi. Enta leruo tse di itekanetse go sireletsa.
learn.groundnut rosette.prevention: Tsenya dijalo ka bonako le ka bontsi jo bo kwa godimo (di-aphid di rata dijalo tse di sa jalwang sentle, tse di sa jalwang sentle), fa di le teng di dirise mefuta e e farologaneng e e kgonang go emelana le di-aphid mme di di laole ka dibolayaditshenekegi tse di tshwanetseng.
learn.groundnut rosette.spreads_by: Di-Aphid (Aphis craccivora), tse di fetisang mogare fa di ntse di fepa, di ka anama ka bonako mo tshimong mo dibekeng di le mmalwa fela.
learn.groundnut rosette.symptoms: Dijalo tse di nang le ditlhare tse di omeletseng tse di nang le dithunya tse di sokameng tse di golang; matlhare a tsone a a serolwana kgotsa a a phatsimang; go ka direga gore go se ka ga nna le di-capsule dipe fa di tshwaeditswe fa di sa ntse di le basha.
learn.groundnut rosette.what_to_do: Tlosa le go senya dimela tse di tshwaeditsweng go sa le gale go fokotsa go anama ga tsone. Ga go na kalafi ya dikhemikale fa semela se setse se tshwaeditswe.
learn.healthy cattle.prevention: Boloka ditlhatlhobo tsa metlha, dientiwa le metsi a a hlwekisitsweng le dijo tse di siameng.
learn.healthy cattle.symptoms: Ga go na matshwao a bolwetsi.
learn.healthy cattle.urgency: Ga go na se se tlhokegang
learn.healthy cattle.what_to_do: Dikgomo tsa gago di bonala di itekanetseng. Tswelela go di lebelela ka metlha, di ente le go di fepa sentle.
learn.healthy goat.prevention: Boloka ditlhatlhobo tsa metlha, dientiwa le metsi a a hlwekisitsweng le dijo tse di siameng.
learn.healthy goat.symptoms: Ga go na matshwao a bolwetsi.
learn.healthy goat.urgency: Ga go na se se tlhokegang
learn.healthy goat.what_to_do: Dipodi tsa gago di bonala di itekanetseng. Tswelela go di lebelela ka metlha le go di tlhokomela sentle.

learn.healthy potato.symptoms: Ga go na matshwao a bolwetsi.
learn.healthy potato.urgency: Ga go na se se tlhokegang

learn.healthy watermelon.symptoms: Ga go na matshwao a bolwetsi.
learn.healthy watermelon.urgency: Ga go na se se tlhokegang

learn.heartwater.prevention: Go laola ditshenekegi ka metlha ka go di nwetsa kana ka go di alafa ka di-acaricide, le ka go di laola go fokotsa ditshenekegi tsa ditshenekegi.
learn.heartwater.spreads_by: Go loma ga ditshenekegi tsa bont tse di tshwaeditsweng (mofuta wa Amblyomma).
learn.heartwater.symptoms: Go na le letshoroma le le kwa godimo, go sa tlhole go na le keletso ya dijo, matshwao a boboko a a akaretsang go dikologa, go tsamaya ka dikgato tse di kwa godimo le go nna le ditlhabi; go nna le metsi mo pelong le mo makgwafong.
learn.heartwater.what_to_do: Ikgolaganye le ngaka ya diphologolo go bona kalafi ya dibolayamegare (tetracyclines) ka bonako fela fa matshwao a tlhaga  Kalafi e e simololang e ka tokafatsa menyetla ya gore motho a tshele sentle.
learn.lumpy cow disease.prevention: Entiwa ya ngwaga le ngwaga, taolo ya dikeledi, tlhokomelo ya leruo.
learn.lumpy cow disease.spreads_by: Dikeledi (dimosetlhe, diphefo), kopano le leruo tse di lweleng
learn.lumpy cow disease.symptoms: Ditshwepe tse di phahamileng mo mmeleng, feberu, molapo wa nko, pholo e e fokotsegile, maotwana a a bidibala.
learn.lumpy cow disease.what_to_do: Arola dikgomo tse di amegeng. Ikgolaganya le ngaka ya leruo go bona kalafi. Enta lolelo lote. Laola dikeledi mo tshimong.
learn.maize streak virus.affects: Mmidi, le dimela tse dingwe tsa dithoro.
learn.maize streak virus.prevention: Tsenya mefuta e e farologaneng ya mmidi e e kgonang go emelana le bolwetse kgotsa e e kgonang go emelana le jone, laola ditlhopha tsa di-leafhopper, mme o tile go jala dimela gaufi le masimo a bogologolo a mmidi a a tshwaeditsweng.
learn.maize streak virus.spreads_by: Di-leafhopper (mofuta wa cicadulina), tse di tsayang mogare mo dimeleng tse di tshwaeditsweng mme di o anamisa fa di ntse di ja tse di itekanetseng.
learn.maize streak virus.symptoms: Go na le mela e ditshesane e e tshesane e e tshesane e e tshweu-bosweu e e tsamayang e tsamaisana le ditshika tsa matlhare; kgolo e e kgoreletsang e bile go na le tlhabololo e e sa siamang ya ditshika mo mabakeng a a masisi.
learn.maize streak virus.what_to_do: Tlosa le go senya dimela tse di tshwaeditsweng thata fa go kgonega. Ga go na kalafi fa semela se setse se tshwaeditswe.
learn.newcastle disease.affects: Dikgoho tsa dikgogo ke tsone tse di nang le bothata jo bogolo; gape di ama dinonyane tse dingwe.
learn.newcastle disease.prevention: Romela mebutla ya dinonyane ka nako e e beilweng, o thibele baeng go tsena mo dikagong tsa dinonyane tsa dinonyane tsa dinonyane tsa dinonyane, o thibele didirisiwa tsa go thibela malwetse le go thibela dinonyane tse disha gore di se ka tsa tsena mo letsomaneng.
learn.newcastle disease.spreads_by: Go kopana ka tlhamalalo le dinonyane tse di tshwaeditsweng, matlakala a a kgotletsweng, didirisiwa, dijo, metsi le go tshwaediwa ke moya ka dikilometara tse dikhutshwane.
learn.newcastle disease.symptoms: Mathata a go hema, letshololo le le tala, go kgokgoga molala kgotsa go idibala, go fokotsega ga go ntsha mae, loso lwa tshoganyetso fa go na le malwetse a a masisi.
learn.newcastle disease.what_to_do: Tlhopha dinonyane tse di lwalang ka bonako mme o ikgolaganye le ngaka ya diphologolo. Ga go na kalafi; thibelo ke yone kgato ya konokono ya go laola fa go sena go tlhomamisiwa gore go na le leroborobo.
learn.potato late blight.prevention: Diriisa mefuta e e ganang bolwetsi, diriisa setlhare sa thibelo sa obomela, efoga maemo a a omeletseng.
learn.potato late blight.spreads_by: Dipora tsa obomela tse di thusiwang ke mowa, pula
learn.potato late blight.symptoms: Dinkatla tse di fifetseng tsa metsi mo matlharen le matlhobong, obomela o o tshweu mo tlase ga matlhare, mekwelo e e bofeng.
learn.potato late blight.what_to_do: Diriisa setlhare ka bonako. Tlosa mme o senya dimela tse di konaletsweng. Efoga go nesa mo godimo ga matlhare.
learn.sorghum anthracnose.prevention: Dirisa mefuta e e farologaneng ya dijalo e e kgonang go emelana le dijalo, o dire gore dijalo di nne kgakala le sorghum ka paka e le nngwe, mme o tile go jala thata go dira gore matlhare a nne a le metsi ka lobaka lo loleele.
learn.sorghum anthracnose.spreads_by: Di-spore tsa di-fungus tse di anamisiwang ke phefo, pula e e fisang le masalela a dijalo a a tshwaeditsweng a a tlogetsweng mo tshimong.
learn.sorghum anthracnose.symptoms: Mabala a mannye a mmala o mohibidu, o mohibidu kgotsa o montsho mo matlhakoreng a a golang le a a kopanelang; mmala o mohibidu mo ditlhomeng; sebopego sa mabele mo ditlhogong tse di tshwaeditsweng mo maemong a a tsididi.
learn.sorghum anthracnose.what_to_do: Tlosa le go senya masalela a dijalo a a tshwaeditsweng morago ga thobo. Kalafi ya dibolayamegare e ka thusa mo malwetseng a a masisi  ikgolaganye le motlhankedi wa katoloso ya diritibatsi tsa diritibatsi tse di amogetsweng mo lefelong la lona.
learn.sorghum cereal grain mold.preventi: Diriisa mefuta e e ganang obomela, efoga go diegelwa ga kotulo, tokafatsa go ntsha metsi mo tshimong.
learn.sorghum cereal grain mold.spreads_: Dipora tsa obomela, pula e e feteletseng
learn.sorghum cereal grain mold.symptoms: Mmala wa boshibidu kgotsa obomela mo dihlohlong tsa lebese, lebese le le senang boleng.
learn.sorghum cereal grain mold.what_to_: Kotula pele ga nako mo dikgaolong tse di nang le pula e ntsi. Omisa lebese ka bonako morago ga kotulo. Diriisa setlhare sa obomela fa o bona matshwao pele.
learn.tomato late blight.prevention: Diriisa mefuta e e ganang bolwetsi, diriisa setlhare sa thibelo sa obomela, tokafatsa go gololosega ga mowa.
learn.tomato late blight.spreads_by: Dipora tsa obomela tse di thusiwang ke mowa, pula
learn.tomato late blight.symptoms: Dinkatla tse di fifetseng tsa metsi mo matlharen le leungong, obomela o o tshweu mo tlase, go wela ga semela ka bonako.
learn.tomato late blight.what_to_do: Diriisa setlhare ka bonako. Tlosa mme o senya dimela tse di konaletsweng. Efoga go nesa mo godimo ga matlhare.
learn.watermelon mosaic virus.prevention: Diriisa mefuta e e ganang bolwetsi, laola diaphid, tlosa magora fa gare ga tshimo.
learn.watermelon mosaic virus.spreads_by: Dikeledi tsa aphid, dimela tse di konaletsweng
